# `app.graycard.meter.defs`

How light was gathered for a reading. Incident measures light falling on the subject (dome integrates 3D form; flat disc measures a plane); reflected measures light returning from the scene, either wide-field or through spot optics.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/meter/defs.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 8

<a id="metergeometry"></a>

## `meterGeometry`

How light was gathered for a reading. Incident measures light falling on the subject (dome integrates 3D form; flat disc measures a plane); reflected measures light returning from the scene, either wide-field or through spot optics.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `incident-dome`, `incident-flat`, `reflected-average`, `reflected-spot`

<a id="lightkind"></a>

## `lightKind`

The temporal character of the measured light.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `ambient`, `flash`, `flash-plus-ambient`

<a id="prioritymode"></a>

## `priorityMode`

Which exposure variable the meter solved for: aperture priority solves shutter, shutter priority solves aperture, iso priority holds time and aperture and solves sensitivity; ev reports EV only.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `aperture-priority`, `shutter-priority`, `iso-priority`, `ev-only`

<a id="flashsyncmode"></a>

## `flashSyncMode`

How a flash measurement was triggered/integrated.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `cordless`, `cord`, `radio`, `hss`, `multi-cumulative`

<a id="readingrole"></a>

## `readingRole`

Role of this reading within a multi-reading workflow (spot memory sets, averaging, contrast evaluation). 'single' is a standalone reading; members of a set share a seriesId.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `single`, `member`, `average`, `shadow`, `highlight`, `midtone`

<a id="sensorpath"></a>

## `sensorPath`

For camera-based (phone) meters: which measurement path produced the value. 'ae-metadata' derives EV from the camera's auto-exposure state; 'raw-patch' integrates linear RAW pixels over the spot patch; 'processed-patch' estimates from tone-mapped frames; 'dedicated-cell' is a hardware photocell (handheld meters).

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `dedicated-cell`, `ae-metadata`, `raw-patch`, `processed-patch`, `ambient-sensor`

<a id="cameramodule"></a>

## `cameraModule`

Phone camera module used for a camera-based reading.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `front`, `ultra-wide`, `wide`, `telephoto`

<a id="calibrationreference"></a>

## `calibrationReference`

What a calibration profile was derived against.

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `reference-meter`, `sunny-16`, `known-illuminant`, `factory`, `manufacturer-spec`
